description: This file defines a mock class COMLinkMock for unit testing the COMLink interface in a C++ project. It includes mock method declarations using Google Mock and inherits from the ICOMLink interface, with functions related to remote connection notifications.

classes.name: COMLinkMock
classes.description: A mock class for the ICOMLink interface used in testing scenarios.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Mocks the registration of a remote connection notification.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Mocks the unregistration of a remote connection notification.

methods.name: RemoteConnection
methods.description: Mocks retrieval of a remote connection by ID.

methods.name: Instantiate
methods.description: Mocks instantiation of an object via RPC and returns a pointer.
